mapper.sql: id, incident_id, status, trigger_source, requested_by, generation_mode, conclusion_status, alert_count, evidence_count, context_truncated, failure_code, started_at, completed_at, create_time, update_time
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sre_investigation_run ( incident_id, status, trigger_source, requested_by, alert_count, evidence_count, context_truncated, started_at, create_time, update_time ) VALUES ( #{incidentId}, #{status}, #{triggerSource}, #{requestedBy}, #{alertCount}, #{evidenceCount}, #{contextTruncated}, #{startedAt}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP )
mapper.update: UPDATE sre_investigation_run SET status = #{status}, generation_mode = #{generationMode}, conclusion_status = #{conclusionStatus}, context_truncated = #{contextTruncated}, report_json = #{reportJson}, failure_code = NULL, completed_at = #{completedAt}, update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'RUNNING'
UPDATE sre_investigation_run SET status = 'FAILED', failure_code = #{failureCode}, completed_at = #{completedAt}, update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'RUNNING'
